content: 九尾狐活动 7上

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Severin, I need everything you have on the Catastrophe Messenger named Biederman.
speaker: Folinic
content: Severin, I need everything you have on the Catastrophe Messenger named Biederman.

speaker: Severin
content: Biederman? Why?

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  An old man told me he saw Biederman leading the riot. He's the one who destroyed the power plant.
speaker: Suzuran
content: An old man told me he saw Biederman leading the riot. He's the one who destroyed the power plant.

raw: [name="Severin"]  An old man? Is he a reliable source?
speaker: Severin
content: An old man? Is he a reliable source?

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  He called himself 'the last of the Winterwisps.'
speaker: Suzuran
content: He called himself 'the last of the Winterwisps.'

raw: [name="Severin"]  He... He's still alive? No. He might be a fraud.
speaker: Severin
content: He... He's still alive? No. He might be a fraud.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  A man like that wouldn't lie. It's just my intuition, but I don't think he would ever lie.
speaker: Suzuran
content: A man like that wouldn't lie. It's just my intuition, but I don't think he would ever lie.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  This is his diary and his knife. I took them as keepsakes.
speaker: Suzuran
content: This is his diary and his knife. I took them as keepsakes.

raw: [name="Severin"]  But that means he must be...
speaker: Severin
content: But that means he must be...

raw: [name="Severin"]  I never expected this. I thought all his kind threw themselves into the lake.
speaker: Severin
content: I never expected this. I thought all his kind threw themselves into the lake.

raw: [name="Severin"]  I'll go see him. I... I don't know. Should I go see him?
speaker: Severin
content: I'll go see him. I... I don't know. Should I go see him?

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  He told me the whole story. According to him, the Winterwisps weren't behind this.
speaker: Suzuran
content: He told me the whole story. According to him, the Winterwisps weren't behind this.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  And he had no hate for you. He spoke very calmly.
speaker: Suzuran
content: And he had no hate for you. He spoke very calmly.

raw: [name="Severin"]  I understand why, but the rioters do use the Winterwisp as an excuse for their looting.
speaker: Severin
content: I understand why, but the rioters do use the Winterwisp as an excuse for their looting.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  And it's just that. An excuse.
speaker: Suzuran
content: And it's just that. An excuse.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Even if it's an excuse, they committed crimes. Next, they'll demand we throw open the granary and leave us to starve.
speaker: Severin
content: Even if it's an excuse, they committed crimes. Next, they'll demand we throw open the granary and leave us to starve.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Besides, the Winterwisps have all mixed with the Wolumonders. At this point... *cough* *cough*...
speaker: Severin
content: Besides, the Winterwisps have all mixed with the Wolumonders. At this point... *cough* *cough*...

raw: [name="Severin"]  No matter the excuse, we can't trust them with our lives.
speaker: Severin
content: No matter the excuse, we can't trust them with our lives.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  We have a Catastrophe Messenger who should have died. Not only did he live, but he sparked a rebellion, and nobody even knew about it.
speaker: Folinic
content: We have a Catastrophe Messenger who should have died. Not only did he live, but he sparked a rebellion, and nobody even knew about it.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Putting it all together, it does seem likely that he was behind it.
speaker: Folinic
content: Putting it all together, it does seem likely that he was behind it.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Yes, it makes sense. If Biederman is indeed still alive, he is the one who could foment an uprising. And he knows Wolumonde is on the brink of famine.
speaker: Severin
content: Yes, it makes sense. If Biederman is indeed still alive, he is the one who could foment an uprising. And he knows Wolumonde is on the brink of famine.

speaker: Folinic
content: What about a motive?

speaker: Severin
content: ...The Great Rift.

raw: [name="Severin"]  After the Catastrophe, people blamed him for the damage to the town.
speaker: Severin
content: After the Catastrophe, people blamed him for the damage to the town.

raw: [name="Severin"]  In a matter of months, we stopped at least seven acts of violence against him. There were more we weren't even aware of.
speaker: Severin
content: In a matter of months, we stopped at least seven acts of violence against him. There were more we weren't even aware of.

raw: [name="Severin"]  After that, he shut himself inside and refused to come out. Most days, he drank himself to violent outbursts. That is until Dr. Atro broke down the door of his house.
speaker: Severin
content: After that, he shut himself inside and refused to come out. Most days, he drank himself to violent outbursts. That is until Dr. Atro broke down the door of his house.

speaker: Suzuran
content: Sh-she broke it down?

raw: [name="Severin"]  Dr. Atro reached out to Biederman after he hit rock bottom. From then on, he was usually there helping her with her work.
speaker: Severin
content: Dr. Atro reached out to Biederman after he hit rock bottom. From then on, he was usually there helping her with her work.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  It sounds like they got along?
speaker: Suzuran
content: It sounds like they got along?

raw: [name="Severin"]  Sure, at least on the surface. That's why I never suspected him. Biederman was always melancholic. And even when he worked with Dr. Atro, we never saw him smile.
speaker: Severin
content: Sure, at least on the surface. That's why I never suspected him. Biederman was always melancholic. And even when he worked with Dr. Atro, we never saw him smile.

raw: [name="Severin"]  The more understanding townsfolk like myself tolerated him and his work. But he had enough of an excuse to seek vengeance on us.
speaker: Severin
content: The more understanding townsfolk like myself tolerated him and his work. But he had enough of an excuse to seek vengeance on us.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Emotionally, he has a clear motivation. Not that that means anything.
speaker: Severin
content: Emotionally, he has a clear motivation. Not that that means anything.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Pretty much everyone has some reason or another to try to get back at someone.
speaker: Severin
content: Pretty much everyone has some reason or another to try to get back at someone.

speaker: Folinic
content: Vengeance... it's always vengeance.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  And before you get too comfortable with this, you did tell us Biederman was dead.
speaker: Folinic
content: And before you get too comfortable with this, you did tell us Biederman was dead.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  You didn't positively identify the bodies. So you missed this possibility.
speaker: Folinic
content: You didn't positively identify the bodies. So you missed this possibility.

speaker: Severin
content: But you can't just assume—*cough* *cough*—*hack* *hack*

speaker: Suzuran
content: Are you okay?

speaker: Severin
content: —Just, a moment.

raw: [name="Severin"]  Why did it get all quiet out there?
speaker: Severin
content: Why did it get all quiet out there?

speaker: Tatjana
content: Schultz!

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  The townsfolk are on the move! They... they've gone to siege Zwölftontechnik Strasse!
speaker: Tatjana
content: The townsfolk are on the move! They... they've gone to siege Zwölftontechnik Strasse!

raw: [name="Severin"]  What?! Get out there and stop them!
speaker: Severin
content: What?! Get out there and stop them!

raw: [name="Severin"]  We don't know who might be hiding in Zwölftontechnik Strasse. What if your 'Reunion' is holed up in there?
speaker: Severin
content: We don't know who might be hiding in Zwölftontechnik Strasse. What if your 'Reunion' is holed up in there?

raw: [name="Tatjana"]  I- I tried. But they were too agitated. They wouldn't listen to reason!
speaker: Tatjana
content: I- I tried. But they were too agitated. They wouldn't listen to reason!

speaker: Tatjana
content: They learned about 'Reunion' from somewhere!

speaker: Severin
content: Grr... those excitable yokels!

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  There is a lot of movement in the town.
speaker: Mudrock
content: There is a lot of movement in the town.

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  And also... It looks like someone found their way here.
speaker: Mudrock
content: And also... It looks like someone found their way here.

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  They raised a militia and started combing a town... That means they've already decided to go to war.
speaker: Mudrock
content: They raised a militia and started combing a town... That means they've already decided to go to war.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  The townsfolk know we're here. They want to burn us alive.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: The townsfolk know we're here. They want to burn us alive.

speaker: Mudrock
content: ...Burn?

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  Originium Arts are part of their normal schooling. Even their teamsters can do simple Arts. Starting a fire is easy enough for them.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Originium Arts are part of their normal schooling. Even their teamsters can do simple Arts. Starting a fire is easy enough for them.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  We can't stay here. Will Rhodes Island lead the charge?
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: We can't stay here. Will Rhodes Island lead the charge?

speaker: Mudrock
content: No.

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  I think... it's just the angry people. They see us as villains, drenched in sin. They are the ones who want to drive us away.
speaker: Mudrock
content: I think... it's just the angry people. They see us as villains, drenched in sin. They are the ones who want to drive us away.

speaker: Mudrock
content: That's all.

speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Mudrock.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  Don't forget our people died in this town.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Don't forget our people died in this town.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  We respect your choice, but you're still young... and you don't yet understand the meaning behind this.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: We respect your choice, but you're still young... and you don't yet understand the meaning behind this.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  Just so you know, we're not all that easily roused.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Just so you know, we're not all that easily roused.

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  If we fight, an entire city will come after us.
speaker: Mudrock
content: If we fight, an entire city will come after us.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  If we run, they'll brand us as arsonists, partisans, bandits. What's the difference?
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: If we run, they'll brand us as arsonists, partisans, bandits. What's the difference?

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  The normal Sarkaz way is pretty simple: just destroy the town. Level it. Done.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: The normal Sarkaz way is pretty simple: just destroy the town. Level it. Done.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  The only tricky part was the automatic Arts units. But their infighting already dealt with those.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: The only tricky part was the automatic Arts units. But their infighting already dealt with those.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  Just give the order, and we'll leave the moon to rest forever in the Winterwisp Mountains. Spring... will never come.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Just give the order, and we'll leave the moon to rest forever in the Winterwisp Mountains. Spring... will never come.

speaker: Mudrock
content: Winter... is long, this year.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  Time to make up your mind, Mudrock.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: Time to make up your mind, Mudrock.

raw: [name="Townsfolk"]  Give us back our home! Out with the bandits! Out with the Infected!
speaker: Townsfolk
content: Give us back our home! Out with the bandits! Out with the Infected!

raw: [name="Townsfolk"]  Weapons here! Men, come arm yourselves. Everyone with decent Arts!
speaker: Townsfolk
content: Weapons here! Men, come arm yourselves. Everyone with decent Arts!

raw: [name="Click"]  What's happening? Why does it feel like they're preparing for war?
speaker: Click
content: What's happening? Why does it feel like they're preparing for war?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  That's about right. It is a war.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: That's about right. It is a war.

raw: [name="Click"]  Woah! GreyThroat! Gimme a little warning next time!
speaker: Click
content: Woah! GreyThroat! Gimme a little warning next time!

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  At least, that's what it is to them. They think they're fighting a war.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: At least, that's what it is to them. They think they're fighting a war.

raw: [name="Click"]  But why? Are the other operators okay?
speaker: Click
content: But why? Are the other operators okay?

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  I wouldn't say okay. It seems like Severin didn't want this to happen. Things are getting out of hand.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: I wouldn't say okay. It seems like Severin didn't want this to happen. Things are getting out of hand.

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Folinic says she found some clues. The man in this picture, one Biederman, is now one of our key suspects.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Folinic says she found some clues. The man in this picture, one Biederman, is now one of our key suspects.

raw: [name="GreyThroat"]  Ayerscarpe is operating on his own. Remember this man. We just need to know where he is. He's probably the one behind this insurgency.
speaker: GreyThroat
content: Ayerscarpe is operating on his own. Remember this man. We just need to know where he is. He's probably the one behind this insurgency.

raw: [name="Click"]  Find the bad guy! Got it!
speaker: Click
content: Find the bad guy! Got it!

speaker: GreyThroat
content: What about Reunion?

raw: [name="Click"]  They set themselves up in a small, abandoned hunting village. People go in and out every day, but the big one doesn't move.
speaker: Click
content: They set themselves up in a small, abandoned hunting village. People go in and out every day, but the big one doesn't move.

raw: [name="Click"]  Oh, and while I was figuring out which way to go, I found a small group that seemed to be patrolling around the edge of the town.
speaker: Click
content: Oh, and while I was figuring out which way to go, I found a small group that seemed to be patrolling around the edge of the town.

speaker: GreyThroat
content: It couldn't be...?

speaker: Townsfolk
content: Wh-what's that?!

raw: [name="Townsfolk"]  A rock? A giant made out of stone? G-get some Arts on it! But not fire! Fire's useless!
speaker: Townsfolk
content: A rock? A giant made out of stone? G-get some Arts on it! But not fire! Fire's useless!

raw: [name="Townsfolk"]  Does anyone know any other Originium Arts?! Hurry. We have to stop it!
speaker: Townsfolk
content: Does anyone know any other Originium Arts?! Hurry. We have to stop it!

raw: [name="Rebellious Infected"]  What a bunch of morons! Heads full of music and garbage art! Don't you see this is the end of Wolumonde?!
speaker: Rebellious Infected
content: What a bunch of morons! Heads full of music and garbage art! Don't you see this is the end of Wolumonde?!

raw: [name="Townsfolk"]  I know. But it would've ended quicker if we just handed it over to you.
speaker: Townsfolk
content: I know. But it would've ended quicker if we just handed it over to you.

raw: [name="Rebellious Infected"]  Has Severin ever told you how much food you have stored? Did he say when the town will get back on course? No! Never! There's no hope!
speaker: Rebellious Infected
content: Has Severin ever told you how much food you have stored? Did he say when the town will get back on course? No! Never! There's no hope!

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  Now that we know who could be behind this, we shouldn't be hurting each other like this.

raw: [name="Suzuran"]  Let's go talk to them. We can convince them not to storm the town hall. They know Rhodes Island, so there should be a way.

raw: There is no room for argument or invective on the battlefield. Life passes quickly. Time is short.
content: There is no room for argument or invective on the battlefield. Life passes quickly. Time is short.
Truly.

raw: Neither side knows what to debate.
content: Neither side knows what to debate.

raw: It is unclear why they went to war, why they give their lives in vain.
content: It is unclear why they went to war, why they give their lives in vain.

raw: Indeed. Rather few hold on to any ideals after taking up arms.

raw: But now, before my very eyes, they fight one another, not only with weapons, but also with words. They cast blame along with stones.

speaker: Mudrock
content: Let's go.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  I can tell. You're still reluctant.
speaker: Sarkaz Warrior
content: I can tell. You're still reluctant.

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  Reluctant...? When we came here, we only planned to... No. There's no point. There hasn't been, since we first set foot in Wolumonde.
speaker: Mudrock
content: Reluctant...? When we came here, we only planned to... No. There's no point. There hasn't been, since we first set foot in Wolumonde.

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  We lost four of our people in the fire. I've already stopped so many. But now, the other Infected must be given... perspective.

content: We lost four of our people in the fire. I've already stopped so many. But now, the other Infected must be given... perspective.

raw: [name="Mudrock"]  Otherwise, we will lose control. No. The rage, the longing, will go unsated. We may even turn back to the way we were...

content: Otherwise, we will lose control. No. The rage, the longing, will go unsated. We may even turn back to the way we were...

raw: [name="Sarkaz Warrior"]  If you hate Reunion so much, why did you join in the first place?

content: If you hate Reunion so much, why did you join in the first place?

speaker: Mudrock
content: I thought...

speaker: Mudrock
content: Never mind.
